headline: Web servers expand structure search, charge calculation, and peptide modeling
label: Computational Biomolecular Design Methods
summary: Seven tools published on 2026-07-11 extend AlphaFold DB-scale search and structure-based design workflows.
synthesis: The dominant thread is delivery of structure- and sequence-centric computational methods as free web servers. AlphaFind v2 searches AlphaFold DB and TED domains via embedding pre-filtering and US-align refinement. ACC III provides a web app and API implementing 20 empirical partial-charge methods, storing charges in mmCIF files. EnzymeMiner 2.0 adds expanded sequence mining and predicted Tm, pH, activity, and aggregation. ARTEM Server performs nucleic acid 3D motif search and structure-based alignment, while PockFlex clusters binding pockets across structural ensembles from MD, experiments, or predictions. PEP-EDIT generates and edits 3D complex peptides from BILN sequences, and PROPTIMUS LIVE performs constrained alpha-carbon optimization with GFN-Force-Field. The common novelty is ensemble-, property-, or flexibility-aware steps integrated into accessible servers; the items report no comparative benchmarks.
